import tensorflow as tf
from tensorflow.keras.layers import Input, Conv2D, LeakyReLU, Flatten, Dense, Reshape, Conv2DTranspose, BatchNormalization, Dropout
from tensorflow.keras.models import Model
from tensorflow.keras.optimizers import Adam
import numpy as np

# --- Generador ---
def build_generator(noise_dim):
    model = tf.keras.Sequential()
    model.add(Dense(4*4*512, input_dim=noise_dim))
    model.add(Reshape((4, 4, 512)))

    model.add(Conv2DTranspose(256, (4, 4), strides=(2, 2), padding='same'))
    model.add(BatchNormalization())
    model.add(LeakyReLU(alpha=0.2))

    model.add(Conv2DTranspose(128, (4, 4), strides=(2, 2), padding='same'))
    model.add(BatchNormalization())
    model.add(LeakyReLU(alpha=0.2))

    model.add(Conv2DTranspose(64, (4, 4), strides=(2, 2), padding='same'))
    model.add(BatchNormalization())
    model.add(LeakyReLU(alpha=0.2))

    model.add(Conv2DTranspose(3, (4, 4), strides=(2, 2), padding='same', activation='tanh')) # 3 canales para RGB

    return model

# --- Discriminador ---
def build_discriminator(img_shape):
    model = tf.keras.Sequential()
    model.add(Conv2D(64, (4, 4), strides=(2, 2), padding='same', input_shape=img_shape))
    model.add(LeakyReLU(alpha=0.2))
    model.add(Dropout(0.4))

    model.add(Conv2D(128, (4, 4), strides=(2, 2), padding='same'))
    model.add(BatchNormalization())
    model.add(LeakyReLU(alpha=0.2))
    model.add(Dropout(0.4))

    model.add(Conv2D(256, (4, 4), strides=(2, 2), padding='same'))
    model.add(BatchNormalization())
    model.add(LeakyReLU(alpha=0.2))
    model.add(Dropout(0.4))

    model.add(Flatten())
    model.add(Dense(1, activation='sigmoid'))

    return model

# Configuración
